description: Frozen canonical tx-encoding conformance vectors (COW-1945; version byte added COW-177). Source of truth for cross-impl clients (wallet/SDK). Mirrors types/src/tx_vectors.rs in the node repo. TV1 is the UNSIGNED canonical encoding (all signatures zero) = the signing/digest preimage; TV2 is the same tx SIGNED with fixed_key_hex (RFC-6979 deterministic, so reproducible). Encoding is ordered commonware-codec: a leading u8 protocol version (tx_version), then u64 scalars as UInt varints, fixed-width arrays raw, Transfer amount as fixed 8-byte big-endian u64. Decoders MUST reject any tx_version they don't support.
